name: processInsuranceClaim
shortDescription: Processes insurance claims related to completed appointments with an external insurance platform.
description:
Overview

This function integrates with an external insurance platform to process claims for completed appointments. It gathers necessary patient and appointment details and submits them to the insurance provider.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler, typically after an Appointment status changes to 'completed'. It automates the submission of insurance claims.

Logic

  1. Receive event data indicating a completed Appointment.
  2. Retrieve the Appointment and associated Patient records using ctx.data.get.
  3. Gather all required information for the insurance claim (e.g., patient demographics, appointment details, services rendered).
  4. Transform the data into the format expected by the InsurancePlatform.
  5. Make an authenticated API call to the InsurancePlatform using ctx.service('InsurancePlatform') to submit the claim.
  6. Handle potential API errors and log the claim submission attempt and its outcome using ctx.audit.log.
  7. Return a success or failure status.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • Patient
  • AuditLog

External Services

  • InsurancePlatform
